mentions.name: Cheaspoly
mentions.description: Cheaspoly is an early-stage chess variant that adds an economy layer to chess: like countries buying armies, chess kings can buy pieces. The new rules are designed to be easy to bring into offline games as well.
mentions.source_excerpt:
One of the projects I’d like to highlight is Cheaspoly.

It’s an attempt to make chess a bit more, you know real:) Like countries buy armies, chess kings can buy figures. Also it’s easy to bring these new rules into offline games.
mentions.author: skyfantom
